purpose: Isolate persistent kappa accumulation precision while retaining the existing production softening-return algorithm and float material/DP coefficients. No alternative norm, denominator, projection, psi law or all-double material arithmetic is introduced.
link_contract: Root first full-reads this source and links only its new main to the same frozen85 CPU Debug NON-main objects and matching headers used by baseline r2. Production ConsRelationEPsft_fast and all four invariant/material helpers are actually linked, never cloned or recompiled here. The sole test-only copied function is ConsRelationEPsft_history_double; no JSph object or spatial kernel is instantiated. AppInfo is defined in the new main, matching the already resolved baseline link requirement.
exact_companion_changes: Rename the copied ConsRelationEPsft_fast body to static ConsRelationEPsft_history_double
Change persistent input kplastic, output nkplastic and local tk from float to double
Pass float(tk) explicitly to the ACTUAL linked UpdateDPvars and Updatedfdk
unchanged_algorithm: Every material input, Bulk/Shear input and DP_phi/DP_kc/DP_psi remains float
The exact existing full-flow dkflowcoef, plus dfdk term and frozen trial coefficients remain
The existing err=1e-5f, tensile/apex branch and old-strength radial projection remain in the same order
No implicit return, denominator sign flip, deviatoric norm substitution, new-strength re-projection or Eq19 psi softening
No new global precision option, production state array or public configuration

material.companion_persistent_history_dtype: double with float conversion at BOTH material helper entries

loading_contract: Each path starts from identical double diagonal stress at mean compression20kPa and the actual linked float-coefficient yield surface for its initial kappa. At every update BOTH branches add the same fixed external deviatoric stress increment (+dq to xx,-dq to zz) to their OWN previous returned stress. Each branch carries its own history continuously; kappa or trial stress is never reset between increments. The second path is an explicitly synthetic high-history probe, not a continuation of the first or a collapse observation. Sub-ULP behavior is observed, not forced to pass.
measurements: All six double EFFECTIVE stress components; mean_effective_compression=-trace(effective stress)/3. There is NO pore-pressure state or equation. Persistent and material-entry kappa, actual increments and both float/material versus persistent ULPs; linked DP_kc cone-intercept strength; trial/returned yield using old and new MATERIAL float kappa; zero-history-write/nonzero-stress-return flags; paired effective-stress/mean/kappa/kc differences. No separate all-double material-law reference is mixed into these measurements.
timing: A single steady_clock measurement covers BOTH paths including CSV/diagnostics. It describes one tiny probe overhead only, not per-branch speed or any production/case performance. No timing ratio or long-run extrapolation is produced.
completion_semantics: Only fresh-output, finite-observation and write checks. It may complete with negligible/no stress differences or with remaining new-kappa yield residuals. No accuracy-improvement threshold, formula acceptance, sub-ULP success threshold or physical pass is imposed.
future_execution: CLI is FRESH_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY whose parent already exists. Root reviews and separately builds/runs once if authorized; no automatic subprocess/build/next stage exists in this program. No execution was performed by the author.
limits: Only cohesion-softening psi+2.5deg and two compressive diagonal paths; the previous36 observations are retained without rerun
Double persistence still samples strength/dfdk at rounded float kappa; this deliberately isolates accumulation and does not make material arithmetic fully double
Existing full-versus-deviatoric and denominator-sign issues remain; double history is not asserted to cure them
No spatial u-pl plastic, predictor/corrector history commit, GPU, walls, gravity, pore-pressure, general apex or physical-collapse acceptance
protected: Only this new test source and note were authored. Production source, README, prior notes/outputs, frozen objects/programs/source snapshots and Cryer package dependencies remain untouched. No hash scan, Git operation, build or program run.
